newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hubco rebounds, rises sharply.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hubco rebounds, rises sharply.

text.p: Pakistan's private Hub Power Co Ltd 10-rupee stock, which opened at 37.35 rupees on Monday, rebounded to 37.80 on short-covering in the morning session at the Karachi Stock Exchange, dealers said.
The scrip rebounded after Water and Power Minister Nisar Ali Khan ruled out the termination of its power purchase agreement with the state water and power utility, one dealer said.
Speculators sold the stock in a falling market on Friday after the Water and Power Development Authority served a notice on Hubco threatening to terminate the agreement.
